itemKeys: Glam Rock TD is officially out on Google Play!
Play through the story levels, unlock new towers and upgrade them with power ups.
Jump into Endless mode and see how long you can keep the show going.
Open the Bestiary to get to know every enemy you'll face.
Create your profile to save your progress and your collection.
A brand new look for the whole game, with redesigned menus and smooth animations.
New music and sounds for every level.
Plenty of balance tweaks, new translations and fixes to keep the show running smoothly.
